title: Long tracks
statementMd:
List tracks longer than 6 minutes (360 seconds) with their length in seconds. Show only the first 10 by id.

Expected columns: `id`, `title`, `seconds`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT id, title, seconds FROM tracks WHERE seconds > 360 ORDER BY id LIMIT 10;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
